verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own controls for devbox automatic shutdown and idle behavior, plus suspend/resume that preserves state so long-running agent work (e.g., waiting on PR feedback) can continue later. The evidence never states how long a devbox can stay continuously running, so support for hours-or-days sessions is implied rather than proven. Suspend/resume preserves state across a pause but is not the same as an uninterrupted session. Missing for 10: documented maximum session lifetime or timeout limits for multi-hour/multi-day runs, explicit configuration for disabling or extending auto-shutdown, independent or hands-on corroboration of long-duration sessions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep a sandbox session running for hours or days for long agent tasks

citations.quote: Control devbox automatic shutdown and idle behaviors
Pause sandboxes to save state and costs, then resume exactly where you left off
Suspend your devbox to preserve state, wait for PR feedback, and resume to continue working iterativ
They give agents a persistent event stream that lets them suspend when idle, wake on demand, recover state, and hand off between agents
